expected_answers.TQ-001: For a change-of-mind return, consumers have a 14-day cooling-off period under the EU Consumer Rights Directive. You must notify Omnia Retail within 14 days of delivery and return the item within 14 days of notification. Return shipping for change-of-mind is at your expense unless the item is defective. Refunds are processed within 14 days of receiving the returned goods.
expected_answers.TQ-002: Unexpected shutdowns are often caused by overheating. Use the laptop on a hard, flat surface to avoid blocking vents. Check Event Viewer for Event ID 41 (Kernel-Power) entries around the shutdown times. Run built-in diagnostics including battery and thermal tests.
expected_answers.TQ-003: For video editing, 32GB of RAM is the recommended choice, especially for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and 4K workflows. 16GB can work for lighter editing but is more of a minimum than ideal. 64GB or more is needed for professional 4K/8K multicam editing and heavy effects work.
expected_answers.TQ-004: If tracking shows delivered but you haven't received the item, first check with neighbours and any safe places where the courier may have left it. Then contact Omnia Retail support with your order number. They will contact the carrier on your behalf and open a trace request if the parcel cannot be located.
expected_answers.TQ-005: Under Irish and EU consumer law, you have statutory warranty rights for up to two years. A fault developing within 10 months is well within this period, and the burden of proof is on the retailer. Omnia Retail will offer repair, replacement, or refund depending on the nature of the defect.
expected_answers.TQ-006: Yes, Omnia Retail offers business pricing with volume discounts for bulk orders. Contact the business sales team for more details.
expected_answers.TQ-007: NVMe SSDs use PCIe lanes with the NVMe protocol, offering much faster speeds than SATA SSDs. SATA SSDs offer around 500-550 MB/s read speeds, while NVMe Gen 3 reaches 3,000-3,500 MB/s and Gen 4 reaches 5,000-7,000 MB/s. NVMe is recommended as the primary drive for operating system, applications, and active files. SATA SSDs are good for budget upgrades and secondary storage where cost per GB matters more than speed.
expected_answers.TQ-008: For a budget home office, prioritise an external monitor first (27-inch 1440p is the best value), then a laptop stand with an external keyboard and mouse for ergonomics, followed by a USB-C hub or dock for connectivity.
expected_answers.TQ-009: A clicking noise from an external hard drive typically indicates a physical drive failure. Stop using the drive immediately to prevent further data loss. Do not attempt to open the drive. Contact a professional data recovery service if the data is important, or pursue a warranty replacement.
expected_answers.TQ-010: Yes, Omnia Retail participates in the WEEE (Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment) scheme. Customers can return old electronics when purchasing a new equivalent product, free of charge. This is in compliance with Irish WEEE regulations.

additional_queries.expected_answer: Within Ireland, standard delivery takes 2-4 business days after dispatch. Express delivery offers next business day delivery if ordered before 14:00. Saturday delivery is also available if ordered by 14:00 on Friday.

additional_queries.query: Should I get an Intel or AMD processor for my laptop?
additional_queries.expected_answer: Both Intel and AMD are excellent choices. AMD typically offers better value, battery efficiency, and multi-core performance, making it ideal for productivity and budget-conscious buyers. Intel has a slight edge in single-threaded performance and Thunderbolt 4 support. For most users doing office work, browsing, and streaming, either is fine — the specific model and generation matters more than the brand.

additional_queries.query: I bought a monitor from you last week and found it cheaper at another shop. Can I get a refund of the difference?
additional_queries.expected_answer: Yes, Omnia Retail offers a price match within 7 days of purchase. You need to provide your order number, proof of purchase, and evidence of the competitor's current price for an identical product (same model, SKU, and specifications). The competitor item must be in stock and available for purchase. If approved, the difference is refunded to your original payment method.

additional_queries.query: My monitor arrived with a cracked screen. The box was damaged too.
additional_queries.expected_answer: Contact Omnia Retail support as soon as possible with your order number and photos of the damaged box and screen. Keep all packaging and the monitor as received. If the damage occurred in transit, a replacement can typically be arranged.

additional_queries.query: Can I cancel my order if it hasn't shipped yet?
additional_queries.expected_answer: Yes, you can cancel your order before it has been dispatched. A contract is formed when the dispatch confirmation email is sent, so cancellation is possible before that point.

additional_queries.query: What size and resolution monitor should I get for working from home?
additional_queries.expected_answer: For working from home, a 27-inch 1440p (QHD) monitor is the recommended sweet spot. It offers sharp text for productivity, good screen real estate, and strong value. 1080p is acceptable on 24-inch or smaller screens but looks pixelated at 27 inches. 4K is excellent on 27-32 inch monitors but costs more and requires a stronger GPU.

additional_queries.query: How do I delete my account and what happens to my data?
additional_queries.expected_answer: To delete your Omnia Retail account, contact privacy@omniaretail.ie. Account deletion is processed within 30 days in accordance with GDPR. Note that orders, invoices, and transaction records may be retained for up to 7 years for legal and financial compliance, but retained data is not used for marketing.
